item.description:
Pasteback 0.5.0 — Choose, paste, keep going / 选中，粘贴，继续工作
• Lightweight non-activating quick panel with search, arrow-key selection, Return, Esc, Cmd1–9 and Option-Return for file paths. Your full window remains available from the menu bar. • Short, skippable automatic-paste setup. Enable it after granting Accessibility permission; copy-only mode remains available. • Customizable global shortcut with conflict protection. Pinned items appear above recent items. • Subtle menu-bar copy feedback. C++ previews remain in the full workspace. • Universal Clipboard source label when a cross-device marker is available; the originating device is not guessed.
• 快捷浮层用于日常找回与粘贴，大窗口用于整理和阅读 C++。 • 可跳过的首次引导，用户主动开启并授权后启用自动粘贴。 • 自定义快捷键、冲突保护、固定项独立置顶与克制的复制反馈。 • 跨设备标记可用时显示“通用剪贴板”，不推测具体来源设备。
History stays on this Mac. This testing build is not Apple notarized; first-launch Gatekeeper restrictions remain. 历史保留在本机。此测试版尚未完成 Apple 公证，首次启动仍可能被系统拦截。
